subject: Re: Encord Contract Renewal
text:
Hi Alyssa,

Unfortunately, I cannot make that work tomorrow. Can you send the latest
quote via email, so I have it as a reference?

Based on my discussions with Jonathan, the proposed pricing represents a
~65% increase year over year, which unfortunately does not fit within my
2026 budget.

   - 2025: $35,000
   - 2026: $52,500 + $5,250 = $57,750

I had planned for a 10–15% increase, accounting for additional users, but
this proposal comes in $17,500 above that range. I’d prefer to continue
working together rather than explore alternative providers, but we’ll need
to bring this closer to our budget to do so.

What options do you have to adjust pricing or structure to get us closer to
that range?

Thanks,
--
Matt Falk
CTO <https://www.linkedin.com/in/matt-falk-55648330/> | Zeitview

subject: Re: Encord Call Today
text:
Hey Collin,

Unfortunately after some additional internal discussions weve determined that we wont move forward with the Encode tool. The main reasons for this decision are the cost, which is much higher than competitor tools. In addition, comparing the keypoint annotation performance (based on the demo you showed) to other tools weve evaluated, im not seeing throughput improvements that would justify the extra cost for us. With all the being said, Encode is certainly the most polished tool ive seen, so maybe down the line as we scale up and have more annotation work we can reconnect and see if Encode is right for Vitalacy.

Because of this choice id like to cancel our call this afternoon. Thanks so much for your time and support.

Best,
Max Smalley
